title: NodeState
description: A node's current state, as its graph events project it (docs/design/m0/13 "Evaluation"). waiting: some inputs have no applicable result yet (a structural wait, no hold). runnable: every input resolved, not claimed. Evaluation is demand-driven, so only a goal that demands the node claims it; a runnable node no goal demands stays runnable. held: one or more external waits, each with its hold, which may also list inputs still missing; this includes a could_not_run that retries on its signal (13 [G2]). claimed: its inputs are fixed and its key computed, in one writer transaction (13 [G10]). completed: a result is selected. superseded: a replacement node took over (13), possibly after it completed. internal/graph owns the transitions and refuses a node that supersedes itself.

waiting_on.description: The names of the inputs still missing: non-empty while waiting, possibly non-empty while held, empty otherwise.

key.description: Set from the claim on, never while waiting or runnable, and always when a result is selected. A held or superseded node has one only if it was claimed first.

holds.description: The node's external waits, one per signal it awaits (13; 04: each owed input is its own wait): non-empty exactly while held, empty otherwise. internal/graph checks that hold ids are unique; the schema refuses exact duplicates.

result.description: The selected result: set when completed, kept when a completed node is superseded, null otherwise.

superseded_by.description: The replacement node; set exactly when superseded.
